title: TiWeaver: Unified Temporal Dynamics Modeling via Contextual Patching

problem.claim: Multivariate time series forecasting must handle diverse temporal dynamics, irregularities, and asynchronous dependencies across channels.

gap.claim: A model using one fixed patching scheme often adapts poorly to diverse multivariate time series.

contributions.claim: TiWeaver is a unified framework for adaptively handling temporal dynamics and fine-grained inter-channel dependencies.
G2AT creates contextually coherent patches by jointly considering temporal density and representation consistency.
FADE models fine-grained asynchronous inter-channel dependencies while incorporating long-term historical dependencies.

author_reported_evidence.claim: On 12 real-world time series datasets, TiWeaver achieves state-of-the-art performance and outperforms existing methods by up to 25%.
The authors report robustness and effectiveness across diverse domains and data characteristics.

narrative_sequence.summary: Multivariate time series forecasting is important in real-world applications.
Diverse sources create irregularities and asynchronous temporal dependencies across channels.
Fixed patching schemes may not adapt adequately to diverse multivariate time series.
TiWeaver addresses the challenge using adaptive temporal modeling, G2AT, and FADE.
The authors report strong results across 12 real-world datasets and diverse domains.
